tooltip_offset.title: Start time
body: Time at which the media will start.

tooltip_range.title: Range
tooltip_range.body: Maximum distance (in meters) at which the player is visible/audible.

tooltip_same_room.title: Attenuation (same room)
body: Rate at which sound fades when moving away within the same room.
A value of `0` means no decrease.

tooltip_diff_room.title: Attenuation (different room)
body: Rate at which sound fades when moving away in a different room.
A value of `0` means no decrease.

tooltip_diff_room_vol.title: Volume (different room)
body: Ratio by which the player's base volume is reduced when in a different room.
A value of `1` means the volume stays the same.

tooltip_vehicle_mode.title: Vehicle mode
tooltip_vehicle_mode.body: If enabled, the entity is a vehicle: the interior counts as the same room, the exterior as different.

tooltip_enable_scaleform.title: Enable Scaleform
tooltip_enable_scaleform.body: Play media on a scaleform instead of an object's render target.
